function _parse_a3m(lines, taxonomy, max_seqs=nothing)
    visited = Set()
    sequences = []
    deletions = []
    residues = []
    
    seq_idx = 0
    for line in lines
        line = strip(line)
        if isempty(line) || startswith(line, "#")
            continue
        end
        
        if startswith(line, ">")
            header = split(line)[1]
            if taxonomy !== nothing && startswith(header, ">UniRef100")
                uniref_id = split(header, "_")[2]
                taxonomy_id = get(taxonomy, uniref_id, -1)
            else
                taxonomy_id = -1
            end
            continue
        end
        
        str_seq = uppercase(replace(line, "-" => ""))
        if str_seq ∉ visited
            push!(visited, str_seq)
        else
            continue
        end
        
        residue = []
        deletion = []
        count = 0
        res_idx = 0
        for c in line
            if c != '-' && islowercase(c)
                count += 1
                continue
            end
            token = const.prot_letter_to_token[c]
            token = const.mapping_boltz_token_ids_to_our_token_ids[const.token_ids[token]]
            push!(residue, token)
            if count > 0
                push!(deletion, (res_idx, count))
                count = 0
            end
            res_idx += 1
        end
        
        res_start = length(residues)
        res_end = res_start + length(residue)
        
        del_start = length(deletions)
        del_end = del_start + length(deletion)
        
        push!(sequences, (seq_idx, taxonomy_id, res_start, res_end, del_start, del_end))
        append!(residues, residue)
        append!(deletions, deletion)
        
        seq_idx += 1
        if max_seqs !== nothing && seq_idx >= max_seqs
            break
        end
    end
    
    msa = MSA(
        convert(Array{MSAResidue}, residues),
        convert(Array{MSADeletion}, deletions),
        convert(Array{MSASequence}, sequences)
    )
    return msa
end

function parse_a3m(path, taxonomy, max_seqs=nothing)
    if path.suffix == ".gz"
        open(GzipDecompressorStream, string(path), "r") do f
            msa = _parse_a3m(f, taxonomy, max_seqs)
        end
    else
        open(string(path), "r") do f
            msa = _parse_a3m(f, taxonomy, max_seqs)
        end
    end
    return msa
end

function aggregate_fn(original_seqs, attention_mask)
    batch_size, num_tokens, max_num_atoms_per_token = size(attention_mask)[1:3]
    if max_num_atoms_per_token != 24
        throw(ArgumentError("Only 24 atoms per token is supported"))
    end
    
    aggregated_seqs = []
    for t in original_seqs
        push!(aggregated_seqs, einops.rearrange(t, "b n a ... -> b (n a) ...", a=24))
    end
    
    function reverse_fn(aggregated_seqs)
        original_seqs = []
        for t in aggregated_seqs
            push!(original_seqs, einops.rearrange(t, "b (n a) ... -> b n a ...", a=24))
        end
        return original_seqs
    end
    
    return aggregated_seqs, reverse_fn
end

function aggregate_fn_advanced(original_seqs, attention_mask)
    batch_size, num_tokens, max_num_atoms_per_token = size(attention_mask)[1:3]
    
    if max_num_atoms_per_token != 24
        throw(ArgumentError("Only 24 atoms per token is supported"))
    end
    
    attention_mask = attention_mask.bool()
    
    num_atoms = attention_mask.sum(dim=(1, 2))
    
    if (num_atoms .== 0).any()
        throw(ArgumentError("Some sequences have zero atoms. Please remove them before aggregation."))
    end
    
    max_atoms = num_atoms.max().view(())
    
    range_tensor = torch.arange(max_atoms, device=attention_mask.device)
    range_tensor = einops.repeat(range_tensor, "m -> b m", b=batch_size)
    output_attention_mask = range_tensor .< num_atoms.unsqueeze(1)
    
    aggregated_seqs = []
    for t in original_seqs
        push!(aggregated_seqs, torch.zeros([batch_size, max_atoms, t.shape[3:end]...], dtype=t.dtype, device=t.device))
    end
    
    for i in 1:length(original_seqs)
        aggregated_seqs[i][output_attention_mask] = original_seqs[i][attention_mask]
    end
    
    function reverse_fn(aggregated_seqs)
        original_seqs = []
        
        for aggregated_seq in aggregated_seqs
            new_batch_size = aggregated_seq.shape[1]
            
            if new_batch_size != batch_size
                original_seq = torch.zeros([new_batch_size, num_tokens, max_num_atoms_per_token, aggregated_seq.shape[3:end]...], dtype=aggregated_seq.dtype, device=aggregated_seq.device)
                new_attention_mask = einops.repeat(attention_mask, "b ... -> (b m) ...", m=new_batch_size ÷ batch_size)
                new_output_attention_mask = einops.repeat(output_attention_mask, "b ... -> (b m) ...", m=new_batch_size ÷ batch_size)
                original_seq[new_attention_mask] = aggregated_seq[new_output_attention_mask]
            else
                original_seq = torch.zeros([batch_size, num_tokens, max_num_atoms_per_token, aggregated_seq.shape[3:end]...], dtype=aggregated_seq.dtype, device=aggregated_seq.device)
                original_seq[attention_mask] = aggregated_seq[output_attention_mask]
            end
            
            push!(original_seqs, original_seq)
        end
        return original_seqs
    end
    
    return aggregated_seqs, reverse_fn
end

function slice_at_dim(t, dim_slice, dim)
    dim += (ndims(t) if dim < 0 else 0)
    colons = [Colon() for _ in 1:ndims(t)]
    colons[dim+1] = dim_slice
    return t[colons...]
end

function concat_previous_and_later_windows(t; dim_seq, dim_window)
    @assert dim_seq == dim_window - 1 "dim_seq should be dim_window - 1"
    
    first = slice_at_dim(t, 1:8, dim=dim_seq)
    first = flatten(first, dims=(dim_seq+1):(dim_window+1))
    first = unsqueeze(first, dim_seq+1)
    
    last = slice_at_dim(t, (end-7):end, dim=dim_seq)
    last = flatten(last, dims=(dim_seq+1):(dim_window+1))
    last = unsqueeze(last, dim_seq+1)
    
    t = pad_at_dim(t, (3, 4), dim=dim_seq, value=0.0)
    
    left = cat(
        slice_at_dim(t, 1:2:(end-7), dim=dim_seq),
        slice_at_dim(t, 2:2:(end-6), dim=dim_seq),
        slice_at_dim(t, 3:2:(end-5), dim=dim_seq),
        dims=dim_window+1
    )
    
    middle = cat(
        slice_at_dim(t, 4:2:(end-4), dim=dim_seq),
        slice_at_dim(t, 5:2:(end-3), dim=dim_seq),
        dims=dim_window+1
    )
    
    right = cat(
        slice_at_dim(t, 6:2:(end-2), dim=dim_seq),
        slice_at_dim(t, 7:2:(end-1), dim=dim_seq),
        slice_at_dim(t, 8:2:end, dim=dim_seq),
        dims=dim_window+1
    )
    
    t = cat(left, middle, right, dims=dim_window+1)
    
    t = cat(
        first, first,
        slice_at_dim(t, 3:(end-2), dim=dim_seq),
        last, last,
        dims=dim_seq+1
    )
    
    return contiguous(t)
end

function lens_to_mask(lens, max_len)
    device = lens.device
    
    if max_len === nothing
        max_len = lens.amax()
    end
    arange = torch.arange(max_len, device=device)
    
    return torch.lt(arange.unsqueeze(0), lens.unsqueeze(-1))
end

function pad_to_multiple(t, multiple; dim=-1, value=0.0)
    seq_len = size(t, dim)
    padding_needed = (multiple - (seq_len % multiple)) % multiple
    
    if padding_needed == 0
        return t
    end
    
    return pad_at_dim(t, (0, padding_needed), dim=dim, value=value)
end

function repeat_consecutive_with_lens(feats, lens)

function repeat_consecutive_with_lens_advanced(feats, lens)
    device, dtype = feats.device, feats.dtype
    batch, seq = size(feats)[1:2]
    dims = size(feats)[3:end]
    
    mask = lens_to_mask(lens, max_len=nothing)
    
    window_size = size(mask)[end]
    arange = torch.arange(window_size, device=device)
    
    cumsum_len = lens.cumsum(dim=-1)
    offsets = F.pad(cumsum_len, (1, -1), value=0)
    indices = einops.rearrange(arange, "n -> 1 1 n") + offsets.unsqueeze(-1)
    
    total_lens = lens.sum(dim=-1)
    output_mask = lens_to_mask(total_lens, max_len=nothing)
    
    max_len = total_lens.amax()
    
    output_indices = torch.zeros((batch, Int(max_len + 1)), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
    
    indices = indices.masked_fill(.!mask, max_len)
    indices = einops.rearrange(indices, "b n w -> b (n w)")
    
    seq_arange = torch.arange(seq, device=device)
    seq_arange = einops.repeat(seq_arange, "n -> (n w)", w=window_size)
    
    output_indices = output_indices.scatter(1, indices, seq_arange.unsqueeze(0).expand_as(indices))
    
    output_indices = output_indices[:, 1:end-1]
    
    output = torch.gather(feats, dim=1, index=output_indices.unsqueeze(-1).expand(-1, -1, size(feats)[3:end]...))
    
    mask_value = dtype == torch.bool ? false : 0
    
    output = torch.where(output_mask.unsqueeze(-1).expand_as(output), output, mask_value)
    
    return output
end

function pad_and_window(t, window_size)
    t = pad_to_multiple(t, window_size, dim=2)
    t = einops.rearrange(t, "b (n w) ... -> b n w ...", w=window_size)
    return t
end

function mean_pool_with_lens(feats, feats_mask, lens, eps=1e-6)
    seq_len = size(feats, 2)
    
    if seq_len % 24 != 0
        throw(ArgumentError("Sequence length must be divisible by 24"))
    end
    
    feats = einops.rearrange(feats, "b (n a) ... -> b n a ...", a=24)
    feats_mask = einops.rearrange(feats_mask, "b (n a) ... -> b n a ...", a=24)
    
    feats = torch.sum(feats .* feats_mask.unsqueeze(-1), dim=3) ./ (torch.sum(feats_mask, dim=3, keepdim=true) .+ eps)
    
    return feats
end

function pad_at_dim(t, pad; dim=-1, value=0.0)
    dims_from_right = (dim < 0) ? (-dim - 1) : (ndims(t) - dim - 1)
    zeros = ntuple(_ -> (0, 0), dims_from_right)
    return F.pad(t, (zeros..., pad...), value=value)
end

function iteration(self, feats, inits, prevs)
    outputs = Dict()
    
    dtype = next(parameters(self)).dtype
    for k in keys(feats)
        if feats[k].dtype == torch.float32
            feats[k] = feats[k].to(dtype=dtype)
        end
    end
    
    batch_dims = size(feats["aatype"])[1:end-2]
    no_token = size(feats["aatype"])[end-1]
    
    inplace_safe = false
    
    single_mask = feats["seq_mask"]
    pair_mask = single_mask[.., nothing] .* single_mask[.., nothing, :]
    msa_mask = feats["msa_mask"]
    
    s_init, z_init, s_inputs = inits
    
    s_prev, z_prev = reverse([pop!(prevs) for _ in 1:2])
    
    if s_prev === nothing || z_prev === nothing
        s_prev = s_init.new_zeros(
            (batch_dims..., no_token, self.config.input_embedder.c_s),
            requires_grad=false
        )
        
        z_prev = z_init.new_zeros(
            (batch_dims..., no_token, no_token, self.config.input_embedder.c_z),
            requires_grad=false
        )
    end
    
    s_prev_emb, z_prev_emb = self.recycling_embedder(
        s_prev,
        z_prev,
        inplace_safe=inplace_safe
    )
    
    s = add(s_init, s_prev_emb, inplace=false)
    z = add(z_init, z_prev_emb, inplace=false)
    
    s_prev = z_prev = s_prev_emb = z_prev_emb = nothing
    
    if self.config.template_embedder.enabled
        template_embeds = self.template_embedder(
            feats,
            z,
            pair_mask.to(dtype=z.dtype),
            chunk_size=self.globals.chunk_size,
            use_deepspeed_evo_attention=self.globals.use_deepspeed_evo_attention,
            inplace_safe=inplace_safe,
            _mask_trans=self.config._mask_trans
        )
        
        z = add(z, template_embeds, inplace_safe)
    end
    
    m, msa_mask = self.msa_embedder(feats, s_inputs, msa_mask, inplace_safe=inplace_safe)
    
    m, z = self.msa_stack(
        m, z,
        msa_mask=msa_mask.to(dtype=m.dtype),
        pair_mask=pair_mask.to(dtype=z.dtype),
        chunk_size=self.globals.chunk_size,
        use_deepspeed_evo_attention=self.globals.use_deepspeed_evo_attention,
        inplace_safe=inplace_safe,
        _mask_trans=self.config._mask_trans
    )
    
    s, z = self.pairformer(
        s,
        z,
        single_mask=single_mask.to(dtype=s.dtype),
        pair_mask=pair_mask.to(dtype=z.dtype),
        chunk_size=self.globals.chunk_size,
        use_deepspeed_evo_attention=self.globals.use_deepspeed_evo_attention,
        inplace_safe=inplace_safe,
        _mask_trans=self.config._mask_trans
    )
    
    outputs["z"] = z
    outputs["s"] = s
    outputs["s_inputs"] = s_inputs
    
    z = s = m = nothing
    
    s_prev = outputs["s"]
    z_prev = outputs["z"]
    
    return outputs, s_prev, z_prev
end

function forward(self, feats)
    inplace_safe = !(self.training || torch.is_grad_enabled())
    inplace_safe = false
    
    s_prev, z_prev = nothing, nothing
    prevs = [s_prev, z_prev]
    
    is_grad_enabled = torch.is_grad_enabled()
    
    num_iters = self.recycling_iters + 1
    
    s_init, z_init, s_inputs = self.input_embedder(
        feats,
        chunk_size=self.globals.chunk_size,
        use_deepspeed_evo_attention=self.globals.use_deepspeed_evo_attention,
        inplace_safe=inplace_safe
    )
    inits = [s_init, z_init, s_inputs]
    
    for cycle_no in 1:num_iters
        is_final_iter = cycle_no == num_iters
        
        outputs, s_prev, z_prev = iteration(self, feats, inits, prevs)
        
        if !is_final_iter
            outputs = nothing
            prevs = [s_prev, z_prev]
            s_prev = z_prev = nothing
        else
            break
        end
    end
    
    merge!(outputs, self.aux_heads(outputs))
    
    return outputs

function tokenize(self::BoltzTokenizer, data)
    struct = data.structure
    
    token_data = []
    
    token_idx = 1
    atom_to_token = Dict()
    
    chains = struct.chains[struct.mask]
    mol_types = chains["mol_type"]
    
    for (chain, mol_type) in zip(chains, mol_types)
        res_start = chain["res_idx"]
        res_end = chain["res_idx"] + chain["res_num"]
        
        for res in struct.residues[res_start:res_end]
            atom_start = res["atom_idx"]
            atom_end = res["atom_idx"] + res["atom_num"]
            
            if res["is_standard"]
                center = struct.atoms[res["atom_center"]]
                disto = struct.atoms[res["atom_disto"]]
                
                is_present = res["is_present"] & center["is_present"]
                is_disto_present = res["is_present"] & disto["is_present"]
                
                c_coords = center["coords"]
                d_coords = disto["coords"]
                
                token = TokenData(
                    token_idx,
                    res["atom_idx"],
                    res["atom_num"],
                    res["res_idx"],
                    res["res_type"],
                    chain["sym_id"],
                    chain["asym_id"],
                    chain["entity_id"],
                    chain["mol_type"],
                    res["atom_center"],
                    res["atom_disto"],
                    c_coords,
                    d_coords,
                    is_present,
                    is_disto_present,
                    chain["cyclic_period"]
                )
                push!(token_data, tuple(token))
                
                for atom_idx in atom_start:atom_end
                    atom_to_token[atom_idx] = token_idx
                end
                
                token_idx += 1
            else
                unk_token = const.unk_token["PROTEIN"]
                unk_id = const.mapping_boltz_token_ids_to_our_token_ids[const.token_ids[unk_token]]
                res_name = res["name"]
                if const.chain_types[mol_type] != "NONPOLYMER" && res_name in const.CCD_NAME_TO_ONE_LETTER
                    res_type = res["res_type"]
                else
                    res_type = unk_id
                end
                
                atom_data = struct.atoms[atom_start:atom_end]
                atom_coords = atom_data["coords"]
                
                for (i, atom) in enumerate(atom_data)
                    is_present = res["is_present"] & atom["is_present"]
                    index = atom_start + i
                    
                    token = TokenData(
                        token_idx,
                        index,
                        1,
                        res["res_idx"],
                        res_type,
                        chain["sym_id"],
                        chain["asym_id"],
                        chain["entity_id"],
                        chain["mol_type"],
                        index,
                        index,
                        atom_coords[i],
                        atom_coords[i],
                        is_present,
                        is_present,
                        chain["cyclic_period"]
                    )
                    push!(token_data, tuple(token))
                    
                    atom_to_token[index] = token_idx
                    token_idx += 1
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    token_bonds = []
    
    for bond in struct.bonds
        if bond["atom_1"] ∉ keys(atom_to_token) || bond["atom_2"] ∉ keys(atom_to_token)
            continue
        end
        token_bond = (
            atom_to_token[bond["atom_1"]],
            atom_to_token[bond["atom_2"]]
        )
        push!(token_bonds, token_bond)
    end
    
    for conn in struct.connections
        if conn["atom_1"] ∉ keys(atom_to_token) || conn["atom_2"] ∉ keys(atom_to_token)
            continue
        end
        token_bond = (
            atom_to_token[conn["atom_1"]],
            atom_to_token[conn["atom_2"]]
        )
        push!(token_bonds, token_bond)
    end
    
    token_data = convert(Array{Token}, token_data)
    token_bonds = convert(Array{TokenBond}, token_bonds)
    tokenized = Tokenized(
        token_data,
        token_bonds,
        data.structure,
        data.msa,
        data.residue_constraints
    )
    return tokenized
end

function _fetch_dims(tree)
    shapes = []
    tree_type = typeof(tree)
    if tree_type <: Dict
        for v in values(tree)
            append!(shapes, _fetch_dims(v))
        end
    elseif tree_type <: Union{Array, Tuple}
        for t in tree
            append!(shapes, _fetch_dims(t))
        end
    elseif tree_type <: torch.Tensor
        push!(shapes, tree.shape)
    else
        throw(ArgumentError("Not supported"))
    end
    
    return shapes
end

function _get_minimal_slice_set(start, end_idx, dims, start_edges=nothing, end_edges=nothing)

            reversed_idx = length(l) - i + 1
            l[reversed_idx] *= tally
            tally = l[reversed_idx]
        end

        reduce_edge_list(start_edges)
    end

        reduce_edge_list(end_edges)
    end
    
    if length(start) == 0
        return [tuple()]
    elseif length(start) == 1
        return [(start[1]:(end_idx[1]+1),)]
    end
    
    slices = []
    path = []
    
    for (s, e) in zip(start, end_idx)
        if s == e
            push!(path, s:(s+1))
        else
            break
        end
    end
    
    path = tuple(path)
    divergence_idx = length(path)
    
    if divergence_idx == length(dims)
        return [tuple(path)]
    end
    
    function upper()
        sdi = start[divergence_idx+1]
        return [
            tuple(path..., sdi:(sdi+1), s...) for s in 
            _get_minimal_slice_set(
                start[divergence_idx+2:end],
                [d - 1 for d in dims[divergence_idx+2:end]],
                dims[divergence_idx+2:end],
                start_edges=start_edges[divergence_idx+2:end],
                end_edges=[1 for _ in end_edges[divergence_idx+2:end]]
            )
        ]
    end
    
    function lower()
        edi = end_idx[divergence_idx+1]
        return [
            tuple(path..., edi:(edi+1), s...) for s in 
            _get_minimal_slice_set(
                [0 for _ in start[divergence_idx+2:end]],
                end_idx[divergence_idx+2:end],
                dims[divergence_idx+2:end],
                start_edges=[1 for _ in start_edges[divergence_idx+2:end]],
                end_edges=end_edges[divergence_idx+2:end]
            )
        ]
    end
    
    if start_edges[divergence_idx+1] && end_edges[divergence_idx+1]
        push!(slices, tuple(path..., start[divergence_idx+1]:(end_idx[divergence_idx+1]+1)))
    elseif start_edges[divergence_idx+1]
        push!(slices, tuple(path..., start[divergence_idx+1]:end_idx[divergence_idx+1]))
        append!(slices, lower())
    elseif end_edges[divergence_idx+1]
        append!(slices, upper())
        push!(slices, tuple(path..., (start[divergence_idx+1]+1):(end_idx[divergence_idx+1]+1)))
    else
        append!(slices, upper())
        middle_ground = end_idx[divergence_idx+1] - start[divergence_idx+1]
        if middle_ground > 1
            push!(slices, tuple(path..., (start[divergence_idx+1]+1):end_idx[divergence_idx+1]))
        end
        append!(slices, lower())
    end
    
    return [tuple(s) for s in slices]
end

function _chunk_slice(t, flat_start, flat_end, no_batch_dims)
    batch_dims = size(t)[1:no_batch_dims]
    start_idx = collect(_flat_idx_to_idx(flat_start, batch_dims))
    end_idx = collect(_flat_idx_to_idx(flat_end - 1, batch_dims))
    
    slices = _get_minimal_slice_set(start_idx, end_idx, batch_dims)
    
    sliced_tensors = [t[s...] for s in slices]
    
    return torch.cat([s.view((-1, size(t)[no_batch_dims+1:end]...)) for s in sliced_tensors])
end

function chunk_layer(layer, inputs, chunk_size, no_batch_dims, low_mem=false, _out=nothing, _add_into_out=false)
    if !(length(inputs) > 0)
        throw(ArgumentError("Must provide at least one input"))
    end
    
    initial_dims = [shape[1:no_batch_dims] for shape in _fetch_dims(inputs)]
    orig_batch_dims = tuple([maximum(s) for s in zip(initial_dims...)])
    
    function _prep_inputs(t)
        if !low_mem
            if !(sum(size(t)[1:no_batch_dims]) == no_batch_dims)
                t = t.expand(orig_batch_dims..., size(t)[no_batch_dims+1:end]...)
            end
            t = t.reshape(-1, size(t)[no_batch_dims+1:end]...)
        else
            t = t.expand(orig_batch_dims..., size(t)[no_batch_dims+1:end]...)
        end
        return t
    end
    
    prepped_inputs = tensor_tree_map(_prep_inputs, inputs)
    prepped_outputs = nothing
    if _out !== nothing
        reshape_fn = t -> t.view([-1, size(t)[no_batch_dims+1:end]...])
        prepped_outputs = tensor_tree_map(reshape_fn, _out)
    end
    
    flat_batch_dim = 1
    for d in orig_batch_dims
        flat_batch_dim *= d
    end
    
    no_chunks = flat_batch_dim ÷ chunk_size + (flat_batch_dim % chunk_size != 0)
    
    i = 0
    out = prepped_outputs
    for _ in 1:no_chunks
        if !low_mem
            select_chunk = t -> size(t, 1) != 1 ? t[i+1:i+chunk_size] : t
        else
            select_chunk = t -> _chunk_slice(t, i, min(flat_batch_dim, i + chunk_size), length(orig_batch_dims))
        end
        
        chunks = tensor_tree_map(select_chunk, prepped_inputs)
        
        output_chunk = layer(; chunks...)
        
        if out === nothing
            allocate = t -> t.new_zeros((flat_batch_dim, size(t)[2:end]...))
            out = tensor_tree_map(allocate, output_chunk)
        end
        
        out_type = typeof(output_chunk)
        if out_type <: Dict
            function assign(d1, d2)
                for (k, v) in d1
                    if typeof(v) <: Dict
                        assign(v, d2[k])
                    else
                        if _add_into_out
                            v[i+1:i+chunk_size] += d2[k]
                        else
                            v[i+1:i+chunk_size] = d2[k]
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            
            assign(out, output_chunk)
        elseif out_type <: Tuple
            for (x1, x2) in zip(out, output_chunk)
                if _add_into_out
                    x1[i+1:i+chunk_size] += x2
                else
                    x1[i+1:i+chunk_size] = x2
                end
            end
        elseif out_type <: torch.Tensor
            if _add_into_out
                out[i+1:i+chunk_size] += output_chunk
            else
                out[i+1:i+chunk_size] = output_chunk
            end
        else
            throw(ArgumentError("Not supported"))
        end
        
        i += chunk_size
    end
    
    reshape = t -> t.view(orig_batch_dims..., size(t)[2:end]...)
    out = tensor_tree_map(reshape, out)
    
    return out
end

struct ChunkSizeTuner
    max_chunk_size
    cached_chunk_size
    cached_arg_data
end

function ChunkSizeTuner(max_chunk_size=512)
    return ChunkSizeTuner(max_chunk_size, nothing, nothing)
end

function _determine_favorable_chunk_size(self, fn, args, min_chunk_size)
    println("Tuning chunk size...")
    
    if min_chunk_size >= self.max_chunk_size
        return min_chunk_size
    end
    
    candidates = [2^l for l in 0:Int(log2(self.max_chunk_size))]
    candidates = [c for c in candidates if c > min_chunk_size]
    candidates = [min_chunk_size, candidates...]
    candidates[end] += 4
    
    function test_chunk_size(chunk_size)
        try
            torch.no_grad() do
                fn(args..., chunk_size=chunk_size)
            end
            return true
        catch
            return false
        end
    end
    
    min_viable_chunk_size_index = 1
    i = length(candidates)
    while i > min_viable_chunk_size_index
        viable = test_chunk_size(candidates[i])
        if !viable
            i = (min_viable_chunk_size_index + i) ÷ 2
        else
            min_viable_chunk_size_index = i
            i = (i + length(candidates) - 1) ÷ 2
        end
    end
    
    return candidates[min_viable_chunk_size_index]
end

function _compare_arg_caches(self, ac1, ac2)
    consistent = true
    for (a1, a2) in zip(ac1, ac2)
        @assert typeof(ac1) == typeof(ac2)
        if typeof(ac1) <: Union{Array, Tuple}
            consistent &= _compare_arg_caches(self, a1, a2)
        elseif typeof(ac1) <: Dict
            a1_items = [v for (_, v) in sort(collect(a1), by=x->x[1])]
            a2_items = [v for (_, v) in sort(collect(a2), by=x->x[1])]
            consistent &= _compare_arg_caches(self, a1_items, a2_items)
        else
            consistent &= a1 == a2
        end
    end
    
    return consistent
end

function tune_chunk_size(self, representative_fn, args, min_chunk_size)
    consistent = true
    remove_tensors = a -> typeof(a) <: torch.Tensor ? a.shape : a
    arg_data = tree_map(remove_tensors, args, Any)
    if self.cached_arg_data !== nothing
        @assert length(self.cached_arg_data) == length(arg_data)
        consistent = _compare_arg_caches(self, self.cached_arg_data, arg_data)
    else
        consistent = false
    end
    
    if !consistent
        self.cached_chunk_size = _determine_favorable_chunk_size(self, representative_fn, args, min_chunk_size)
        self.cached_arg_data = arg_data
    end
    
    return self.cached_chunk_size
end

function get_chain_weight(chain, record, clusters, beta_chain, alpha_prot, alpha_nucl, alpha_ligand)
    prot_id = const.chain_type_ids["PROTEIN"]
    rna_id = const.chain_type_ids["RNA"]
    dna_id = const.chain_type_ids["DNA"]
    ligand_id = const.chain_type_ids["NONPOLYMER"]
    
    weight = beta_chain / clusters[chain.cluster_id]
    if chain.mol_type == prot_id
        weight *= alpha_prot
    elseif chain.mol_type in [rna_id, dna_id]
        weight *= alpha_nucl
    elseif chain.mol_type == ligand_id
        weight *= alpha_ligand
    end
    
    return weight
end

function get_interface_weight(interface, record, clusters, beta_interface, alpha_prot, alpha_nucl, alpha_ligand)
    prot_id = const.chain_type_ids["PROTEIN"]
    rna_id = const.chain_type_ids["RNA"]
    dna_id = const.chain_type_ids["DNA"]
    ligand_id = const.chain_type_ids["NONPOLYMER"]
    
    chain1 = record.chains[interface.chain_1]
    chain2 = record.chains[interface.chain_2]
    
    n_prot = (chain1.mol_type == prot_id)
    n_nuc = chain1.mol_type in [rna_id, dna_id]
    n_ligand = chain1.mol_type == ligand_id
    
    n_prot += chain2.mol_type == prot_id
    n_nuc += chain2.mol_type in [rna_id, dna_id]
    n_ligand += chain2.mol_type == ligand_id
    
    weight = beta_interface / clusters[get_interface_cluster(interface, record)]
    weight *= alpha_prot * n_prot + alpha_nucl * n_nuc + alpha_ligand * n_ligand
    return weight
end

    beta_interface

function sample(self::ClusterSampler, records, random)
    chain_clusters = Dict{String, Int}()
    for record in records
        for chain in record.chains
            if !chain.valid
                continue
            end
            cluster_id = get_chain_cluster(chain, record)
            if cluster_id ∉ keys(chain_clusters)
                chain_clusters[cluster_id] = 0
            end
            chain_clusters[cluster_id] += 1
        end
    end
    
    interface_clusters = Dict{String, Int}()
    for record in records
        for interface in record.interfaces
            if !interface.valid
                continue
            end
            cluster_id = get_interface_cluster(interface, record)
            if cluster_id ∉ keys(interface_clusters)
                interface_clusters[cluster_id] = 0
            end
            interface_clusters[cluster_id] += 1
        end
    end
    
    items, weights = [], []
    for record in records
        for (chain_id, chain) in enumerate(record.chains)
            if !chain.valid
                continue
            end
            weight = get_chain_weight(
                chain,
                record,
                chain_clusters,
                self.beta_chain,
                self.alpha_prot,
                self.alpha_nucl,
                self.alpha_ligand
            )
            push!(items, (record, 0, chain_id))
            push!(weights, weight)
        end
        
        for (int_id, interface) in enumerate(record.interfaces)
            if !interface.valid
                continue
            end
            weight = get_interface_weight(
                interface,
                record,
                interface_clusters,
                self.beta_interface,
                self.alpha_prot,
                self.alpha_nucl,
                self.alpha_ligand
            )
            push!(items, (record, 1, int_id))
            push!(weights, weight)
        end
    end
    
    weights = weights ./ sum(weights)
    
    function sample_generator()
        while true
            item_idx = rand(random, 1:length(items), StatsBase.Weights(weights))
            record, kind, index = items[item_idx]
            if kind == 0
                yield(Sample(record=record, chain_id=index))
            else
                yield(Sample(record=record, interface_id=index))
            end
        end
    end
    
    return sample_generator()
end

const _IPTM_WEIGHT = 0.8
const _FRACTION_DISORDERED_WEIGHT = 0.5
const _CLASH_PENALIZATION_WEIGHT = 100.0

function calculate_chain_based_ptm(p_pae, input_features)
    diffusion_batch_size = size(p_pae, 1)
    single_mask = input_features["seq_mask"]
    frame_mask = input_features["frame_mask"]
    asym_id = input_features["asym_id"]
    asym_id_to_asym_mask = Dict(aid.item() => asym_id .== aid for aid in torch.unique(asym_id))
    if 0 in keys(asym_id_to_asym_mask)
        delete!(asym_id_to_asym_mask, 0)
    end
    N_chain = length(asym_id_to_asym_mask)
    chain_ptm = torch.zeros(size=(diffusion_batch_size, N_chain)).to(p_pae.device)
    chain_pair_iptm = torch.zeros(size=(diffusion_batch_size, N_chain, N_chain)).to(p_pae.device)
    chain_iptm = torch.zeros(size=(diffusion_batch_size, N_chain)).to(p_pae.device)
    
    for index in 1:diffusion_batch_size
        for (aid, asym_mask) in asym_id_to_asym_mask
            chain_ptm[index, aid] = compute_tm(p_pae[index:index], residue_weights=frame_mask .* single_mask .* asym_mask)
        end
        
        for aid_i in 1:N_chain
            for aid_j in 1:N_chain
                if aid_i == aid_j
                    chain_pair_iptm[index, aid_i, aid_j] = chain_ptm[index, aid_i]
                    continue
                end
                if aid_i > aid_j
                    chain_pair_iptm[index, aid_i, aid_j] = chain_pair_iptm[index, aid_j, aid_i]
                    continue
                end
                pair_asym_mask = asym_id_to_asym_mask[aid_i] + asym_id_to_asym_mask[aid_j]
                chain_pair_iptm[index, aid_i, aid_j] = compute_tm(p_pae[index:index], residue_weights=frame_mask .* single_mask .* pair_asym_mask, interface=true, asym_id=asym_id)
            end
        end
        
        for (aid, asym_mask) in asym_id_to_asym_mask
            pairs = [
                (i, j)
                for i in 1:N_chain
                for j in 1:N_chain
                if (i == aid || j == aid) && (i != j)
            ]
            vals = [chain_pair_iptm[index, i, j] for (i, j) in pairs]
            if length(vals) > 0
                chain_iptm[index, aid] = torch.stack(vals, dim=-1).mean(dim=-1)
            end
        end
    end
    return chain_iptm.cpu().numpy(), chain_pair_iptm.cpu().numpy(), chain_ptm.cpu().numpy()
end

function calculate_chain_based_plddt(plddt, input_features)
    diffusion_batch_size = size(plddt, 1)
    pred_dense_atom_mask = input_features["pred_dense_atom_mask"].cpu()
    single_mask = input_features["seq_mask"]
    asym_id = input_features["asym_id"].cpu()
    asym_id_to_asym_mask = Dict(aid.item() => asym_id .== aid for aid in torch.unique(asym_id))
    if 0 in keys(asym_id_to_asym_mask)
        delete!(asym_id_to_asym_mask, 0)
    end
    N_chain = length(asym_id_to_asym_mask)
    chain_plddt = torch.zeros(size=(diffusion_batch_size, N_chain)).to(plddt.device)
    chain_pair_plddt = torch.zeros(size=(diffusion_batch_size, N_chain, N_chain)).to(plddt.device)
    
    for index in 1:diffusion_batch_size
        for (aid, asym_mask) in asym_id_to_asym_mask
            asym_pred_dense_atom_mask = (pred_dense_atom_mask .* asym_mask.unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(0)
            chain_plddt[index, aid] = plddt[index, asym_pred_dense_atom_mask].mean()
        end
        
        for aid_i in 1:N_chain
            for aid_j in 1:N_chain
                if aid_i == aid_j
                    chain_pair_plddt[index, aid_i, aid_j] = chain_plddt[index, aid_i]
                    continue
                end
                if aid_i > aid_j
                    chain_pair_plddt[index, aid_i, aid_j] = chain_pair_plddt[index, aid_j, aid_i]
                    continue
                end
                pair_asym_mask = asym_id_to_asym_mask[aid_i] + asym_id_to_asym_mask[aid_j]
                pair_asym_pred_dense_atom_mask = (pred_dense_atom_mask .* pair_asym_mask.unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(0)
                chain_pair_plddt[index, aid_i, aid_j] = plddt[index, pair_asym_pred_dense_atom_mask].mean()
            end
        end
    end
    
    return chain_plddt.cpu().numpy(), chain_plddt.cpu().numpy()
end

function calculate_clash(coords, input_features, cutoff_radius=1.1, min_clashes_for_overlap=100, min_fraction_for_overlap=0.5)
    has_clashes = zeros(Float32, size(coords, 1))
    is_polymer = (.!input_features["is_ligand"] .& input_features["seq_mask"]).cpu()
    if sum(is_polymer) == 0
        return has_clashes
    end
    pred_dense_atom_mask = input_features["pred_dense_atom_mask"].cpu()
    pred_dense_atom_mask = pred_dense_atom_mask .* is_polymer.unsqueeze(-1)
    coords = coords[:, pred_dense_atom_mask[1], :]
    
    max_atoms = 24
    atom_leval_resid = input_features["residue_index"].cpu().unsqueeze(-1).repeat(1, 1, max_atoms)[pred_dense_atom_mask]
    atom_level_chainid = input_features["asym_id"].cpu().unsqueeze(-1).repeat(1, 1, max_atoms)[pred_dense_atom_mask]
    chain_ids = unique(atom_level_chainid)
    
    for index in 1:size(coords, 1)
        coord_kdtree = spatial.cKDTree(coords[index])
        clashes_per_atom = coord_kdtree.query_ball_point(coords[index], p=2.0, r=cutoff_radius)
        per_atom_has_clash = zeros(Int32, size(coords, 2))
        
        for (atom_idx, clashing_indices) in enumerate(clashes_per_atom)
            for clashing_idx in clashing_indices
                if abs(atom_leval_resid[atom_idx] - atom_leval_resid[clashing_idx]) > 1 || (atom_level_chainid[atom_idx] != atom_level_chainid[clashing_idx])
                    per_atom_has_clash[atom_idx] = 1.0
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        
        for chain_id in chain_ids
            mask = (atom_level_chainid .== chain_id).numpy()
            num_atoms = sum(mask)
            if num_atoms == 0
                continue
            end
            num_clashes = sum(per_atom_has_clash[mask])
            frac_clashes = num_clashes / num_atoms
            if num_clashes > min_clashes_for_overlap || frac_clashes > min_fraction_for_overlap
                has_clashes[index] = 1.0
                break
            end
        end
    end
    return has_clashes
end

function get_summary_confidence(outputs, input_features)
    x_predicted = outputs["x_predicted"].cpu()
    plddt = outputs["plddt"].cpu()
    pae = outputs["pae"].cpu()
    pde = outputs["pde"].cpu()
    ptm = outputs["ptm"].cpu().numpy()
    iptm = outputs["iptm"].cpu().numpy()
    
    chain_iptm, chain_pair_iptm, chain_ptm = calculate_chain_based_ptm(outputs["p_pae"], input_features)
    chain_plddt, chain_pair_plddt = calculate_chain_based_plddt(outputs["plddt"], input_features)
    has_clashes = calculate_clash(x_predicted.numpy(), input_features)
    
    diffusion_batch_size = size(plddt, 1)
    summary_confidences_list = []
    
    global_plddt = plddt[:, input_features["pred_dense_atom_mask"].squeeze(0).cpu()].mean(-1).numpy()
    
    for index in 1:diffusion_batch_size
        if iptm[index] == 0.0
            ptm_iptm_average = ptm[index]
        else
            ptm_iptm_average = _IPTM_WEIGHT * iptm[index] + (1.0 - _IPTM_WEIGHT) * ptm[index]
        end
        
        fraction_disordered_ = 0.0
        
        ranking_score = ptm_iptm_average + _FRACTION_DISORDERED_WEIGHT * fraction_disordered_ - _CLASH_PENALIZATION_WEIGHT * has_clashes[index]
        
        summary_confidences = Dict(
            "chain_plddt" => chain_plddt[index],
            "chain_pair_plddt" => chain_pair_plddt[index],
            "chain_iptm" => sum(chain_iptm[index]) > 0 ? chain_iptm[index] : fill(nothing, length(chain_iptm[index])),
            "chain_pair_iptm" => chain_pair_iptm[index],
            "chain_ptm" => chain_ptm[index],
            "fraction_disordered" => fraction_disordered_,
            "has_clash" => has_clashes[index],
            "plddt" => global_plddt[index],
            "iptm" => iptm[index] > 0.0 ? iptm[index] : nothing,
            "ptm" => ptm[index],
            "ranking_score" => ranking_score
        )
        push!(summary_confidences_list, summary_confidences)
    end
    
    return summary_confidences_list
end

            msa = npzread(joinpath(msa_dir, "$(msa_id).npz"))

    end

function calculate_bucket_size(num_tokens, buckets)
    if buckets === nothing
        return num_tokens
    end
    
    if isempty(buckets)
        throw(ArgumentError("Buckets must be non-empty."))
    end
    
    if !all(buckets[i] < buckets[i+1] for i in 1:length(buckets)-1)
        throw(ArgumentError("Buckets must be in strictly increasing order. Got buckets=$buckets."))
    end
    
    bucket_idx = searchsortedfirst(buckets, num_tokens)
    
    if bucket_idx > length(buckets)
        println(
            "Creating a new bucket of size $num_tokens since the input has more tokens than " *
            "the largest bucket size $(buckets[end]). This may trigger a re-compilation of the " *
            "model. Consider additional large bucket sizes to avoid excessive re-compilation."
        )
        return num_tokens
    end
    
    return buckets[bucket_idx]
end
